searches.reason: Challenge whether strong separation from sampled training negatives teaches sufficiently precise ranking. Seek efficient objectives that distinguish plausible competing items within one GRU4Rec model, without separately fitted scores. Compare approaches using official macro validation HR@10; training margins alone cannot establish improvement.
